events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking it after all these years.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today. Still got that swagger.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the very first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating the enduring legacy of 007 and the iconic films.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedic icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese. A true comedy legend.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that changed everything.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: 46 years ago, the world lost a musical visionary. Remembering John Lennon today.
